description: The chart represents the distribution of task types, comparing two categories. The chart is divided into two slices. The larger slice, colored red, represents "Article generation" and accounts for approximately 83.2% of the total. The smaller slice, colored yellow, represents "Headline generation" and makes up around 16.8%. The percentage labels are shown outside the chart, next to their corresponding labels. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are not visually emphasized. The slices are arranged with the larger slice first, followed by the smaller slice in a clockwise direction.
